data_issues: No label problems: y matches image_id exactly in train and val, and there are no duplicate trials within or across splits. The test split has a covariate shift. Several low-firing units fire less on test trials than on train/val: unit 24 is nearly silent (8% of its train rate, p~1e-5), and units 3, 11, 21, 22 and 23 are at about 45-60% of their train rates (p<0.02). This looks like unit drift or loss across the session. A train-vs-test domain classifier reaches AUC ~0.62, and decoder confidence on test (0.76) is lower than in cross-validation (0.86). The val class counts are also unbalanced (6-14 per class), unlike train (50 each).
